newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hitachi Zosen sees 2nd half profits down.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi Zosen sees 2nd half profits down.

text.p: Ship repair company, Hitachi Zosen Singapore Ltd said on Monday said it expected second half profits to be much lower than its first half figure of Singapore $5.25 million.
The first half figure was down from S$6.07 million in the first half a year earlier.

The company said in a statement new orders for shipbuilding would have no impact on earnings in the second half of the financial year and it did not foresee significant improvement in the shiprepair market in the period.
"The overall profitability for the group in the second half is therefore expected to be much lower than in the first six months," the statement said.
